parents: APPROXIMATION D50: departure/arrival endpoints only; actual worst intermediate condition is not searched.
APPROXIMATION: D50 checks declared departure/arrival endpoints; no worst-intermediate-consumables claim
APPROXIMATION: D57 requires departure, midpoint and arrival samples; these samples do not search the true worst continuous-voyage state
APPROXIMATION: synthetic D29 equivalent cell mass represented as a standard-height ISO20 box
ASSUMPTION Q9: row 1 in every block has reefer plugs; final block permits DG, including reefer DG; detailed DG segregation remains mandatory.
ASSUMPTION: LOCODE labels THLCH/SGSIN/THBKK/USLAX identify synthetic scenarios, not real terminals.
ASSUMPTION: Synthetic governing crane height derived from the existing quay max_on_deck_tier_count; yard/equipment limits remain separate lower caps. Expert Q3 does not establish this port value.
ASSUMPTION: dock water density 1025 kg/m3 (seawater); no measured density is supplied.

ASSUMPTION: legacy documentation only: retained order uses descending full-sounding LCG and canonical tank ID to break ties; it does not control D57 proportional tank fills; no service-tank roles or usual operating practice are inferred.

ASSUMPTION: synthetic consumable draw-down is globally forward first and aft last, using descending full-sounding LCG and canonical tank ID to break ties; no service-tank roles or usual operating practice are inferred.
ASSUMPTION: synthetic lane at the row-1 side of every block; no yard survey is supplied.
ASSUMPTION: synthetic port-side berthing default; no berth survey is supplied.
D27: tank geometry and explicit Tank.kind are declared synthetic design inputs
D34: port labels and profile water densities describe synthetic scenarios, not measured real docks.
D50 default arrival quantity retained by D57: 10% of departure contents
D50 default rule: data/raw/is-code/msc267-85.pdf Part B 3.4.1.2-.3, PDF p.41.
D50: consumption=None selects the vessel policy's default 10% remaining per consumable group.
D50: each declared consumable group retains 0.1 of departure contents unless complete explicit consumption replaces it
D50: no voyage ballast operations are declared or permitted.

D57 DECLARATION: proportional draw-down applies to every consumable tank: mass(r) = departure mass * one common remaining fraction r; symmetric pairs drain together. Default arrival r=0.10; explicit group consumption must imply the same r across all nonempty groups.
DECLARATION: absent from supplied tank catalog: lube_oil, stores
UNVERIFIED: berth/channel draught limit is unknown (None), not an assertion of unlimited draught.
